purpose: Separate gauge-summation fusion from the rejected occupied-slot bitmap.
method: One production/candidate/production comparison. Thirty seconds per point, persistent daemons within each phase, disjoint CPU placement. No local builds, kernel tests or Git packing overlap load. CPU uses before/sent process and thread ticks; 100% is one core. Goodput uses receiver sample bytes/time; missing uses final receiver counts after drain. Counter deltas include drain.
candidate: Accumulate retained-frame and byte gauges during the existing flush_taps lane scan. No bitmap, session-layout change, deadline scan or barrier change.
disposition: Rejected: reverse goodput at 4G falls below both production controls, while high-load effects are mixed.
counter_units: Queue drops count source buffers or control records; a dropped GSO source can contain many frames. TAP and socket drops count SKBs, expiry counts frame classes. Do not sum them as exact frame losses.

checks: sparse slots 0/63 and retained gauges through retirement/expiry
